name: TrendForce
description: Taiwan-based market research firm that publishes quarterly foundry and annual OSAT revenue rankings.

name: Yole Group
description: French market research firm whose advanced-packaging market sizes and wafer splits are the most cited reference for packaging; full reports are paywalled.

name: DIGITIMES Research
description: Taiwan-based technology publisher and research unit that estimates global OSAT revenue.

name: TechSearch International
description: US packaging-focused research firm that co-produces the Worldwide Assembly & Test Facility Database with SEMI.

name: Malaysian Investment Development Authority (MIDA)
description: Malaysia's government investment-promotion agency for manufacturing, including the semiconductor back end.

name: Conventional (wire-bond/leadframe) packaging
description: Wire-bonded chips in leadframe or laminate packages; lower value, labour-intensive, mostly in China and Southeast Asia.

name: Flip-chip packaging
description: Bumped die attached face-down to a substrate; the largest advanced-packaging platform by revenue and the base for 2.5D packages.

name: Wafer-level packaging (fan-in and fan-out)
description: Packaging done on the whole wafer before dicing; fan-in keeps connections within the die, fan-out spreads them into mould compound.
